# Stone Works Remodeling
> Metro Detroit's bathroom remodeling experts — from smart budget renovations to luxury marble master baths. Licensed, insured, 5-year workmanship warranty, serving Michigan's Wayne, Oakland & Macomb Counties since 2009.

## About
Stone Works Remodeling is a licensed and insured bathroom remodeling company based in Livonia, MI, serving all of Metro Detroit since 2009. Led by owner Valjon Qejvani, the company handles every level of project — affordable bathroom updates, mid-range full renovations, tub-to-shower conversions, accessible walk-in tub installations, and high-end luxury master bathrooms with marble, natural stone, heated floors, and spa features. Every project includes a free in-home design consultation with 3D renderings and a 5-year workmanship warranty.

## Services (all budgets)
- Complete bathroom remodeling — budget refresh to full custom renovation
- Tub-to-shower conversion — custom tiled walk-in showers with frameless glass
- Walk-in tub installation — accessible, safety-focused, aging-in-place
- Luxury master bathroom design — marble & natural stone, heated floors, steam showers, freestanding tubs, spa styling
- Custom stone & tile work — marble, slate, quartzite, granite, travertine, porcelain
- Shower remodeling — tile, glass enclosures, niches, benches, rainfall systems

## Pricing (2026, honest ranges)
- Small bathroom update: $5,000 – $10,000
- Tub-to-shower conversion: from $7,995 all-inclusive
- Mid-range full remodel: $15,000 – $30,000
- Walk-in tub installation: $5,000 – $15,000
- Luxury master bathroom: $30,000 – $60,000+
All pricing includes labor, materials, and the 5-year warranty. Free itemized in-home quotes.
